title: Poems
author: France Prešeren
description: The poems of France Prešeren, Slovenia’s national poet, including his sonnets for Julija Primic, a merchant’s daughter he loved from afar. His statue faces the window where she is said to have lived.

title: The Bailiff Yerney and His Rights
author: Ivan Cankar
description: A short novel by Ivan Cankar, the most important Slovene writer of his time, about an old farmhand thrown off the land he worked for 40 years. The city’s main cultural center is named after Cankar.

title: I Saw Her That Night
author: Drago Jančar
description: Drago Jančar’s novel about Veronika, a free-spirited woman from Ljubljana’s upper class who disappears in 1944, told by five people who knew her during the war.

title: Southern Scum Go Home!
author: Goran Vojnović
description: A funny, angry novel about teenagers from immigrant families from other parts of Yugoslavia, growing up in Fužine, a high-rise estate on Ljubljana’s edge. It was a bestseller and a film.

title: Jože Plečnik, 1872–1957: Architectura Perennis
author: Damjan Prelovšek
description: The standard English book on Plečnik by the leading expert on his work, covering his years in Vienna and Prague and his remaking of Ljubljana. His house in Trnovo is now a museum.
